description: Cross-zone demonstration obstacles (2026-10-23). Each lies about 10 m beside the PU College <-> Playground 2 walkway, inside a published cell that walkway crosses, and is sensed only within 4 m: a robot driving the walkway does NOT report it itself; a simulated reporter commissioned at the point does. OB-A and OB-B are in the synthetic EAST zone, OB-C in the synthetic WEST zone (split at cell-centre longitude 77.518, stageCrossZoneDemo.js). Simulation only; physical agents never load this file.
